specs.title: legacy migration validates before writing, retains transcript/cards/draft and quarantines every requirement
future, corrupt, oversized and invalid-provenance storage remain byte-for-byte protected
v2 missing optional fields are neutral and future origins, duplicates and hidden inputs fail
blocked migration writes preserve the original and continue with quarantined in-memory data
history trimming retains older origins and bounds cached cards
invalid pending snapshots and overflowing legacy exclusion unions protect the original copy
browser migrates legacy cards and draft through reload without activating old criteria
browser retains multiplayer across Spider-Man facts, suitability, reload, played and undo
reload retry replays the exact pre-trimming request, keeps the draft and advances one turn
API version skew 422 preserves v2 state and the pending user turn
API version skew legacy-response preserves v2 state and the pending user turn
API version skew invalid-provenance preserves v2 state and the pending user turn
clear in another tab cancels a pending reply and cannot be undone by its late response
main preferences, feedback, saves and history do not enter identical chat requests
R3 recovery and expanded cards stay accessible at 1440px
R3 recovery and expanded cards stay accessible at 390px
R3 recovery and expanded cards stay accessible at 320px
all three selectors retain multiple choices, send their hard constraints and persist after reload
both price handles are draggable, keyboard-accessible, cannot cross, and zero means free only
the complete row is aligned on desktop and menus/range remain accessible at narrow widths
legacy preferences clear hidden terms and preserve an unbounded budget when price metadata is unavailable
desktop feedback sits beside Steam and Save, and details retain only concise essentials
favorites, preferences, saves, feedback and history survive reload and direct saved navigation
played and negative feedback dismiss only their row without reordering or rerunning, persist and can be undone
hard controls explicitly clear stored defaults and no-match results never relax them
changing and restoring criteria during a request does not leave discovery disabled
changing taste during a saved availability check still releases its checking state
clear cancels an in-flight recommendation and removes only this app’s local/session data
same-browser tabs synchronize saves and clearing invalidates another tab’s pending work
corrupt or future device data is not overwritten and the user can explicitly recover
blocked persistence is truthful and the catalog remains useful in memory
removed favorites and saved IDs are retained with an honest availability state
desktop/mobile keyboard, picker, evidence and saved page remain accessible in Current
floating invitation can be dismissed and starter prompts prepare a draft without calling AI
no-game chat replies omit catalog notices, including after reload, while game replies retain them
chat and main discovery have separate inputs and chat never changes the main shortlist or controls
chat card details expand locally with only Save and Steam, sharing bookmarks but no feedback
chat-local rejection carries forward and conversation survives close and reload; New chat clears only chat
chat unavailable errors preserve the failed message and retry does not duplicate it
New chat and Clear my saved data reject late chat responses
corrupt chat storage is protected until an explicit New chat
assistant is keyboard accessible and fits desktop and mobile with catalog cards expanded
assistant session bounds messages, cards and malformed data without importing main defaults
migrates the defined ID-only v1 envelope and forwards only allowlisted preferences
retry rereads shared state before writing and respects another tab’s clear or future format
invalid, oversized and future data is protected; quota failures preserve this tab’s changes
bounded saves, favorites, feedback and history never silently evict an explicit save
clear removes only owned local/session data and rejects all pre-clear responses
tab updates merge a new action onto current device state and stale history cannot resurrect it
